content: {"reasoning":"Medicare has twice denied medical necessity, including after correction and resubmission, so another routine resubmission is unlikely to resolve the claim. A formal medical-necessity appeal is available and can address the disputed diagnosis–procedure pairing using the clinic documentation; authorization is not required and peer-to-peer review is unavailable. The payer appeal path remains open, and the full denied balance is not established as patient responsibility.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
